lines.text: God says the ruler of Tyre claims to be a god, though he is wiser than Daniel and gained wealth by trading.
God says He will bring the most ruthless of nations, who will bring the ruler down to the Pit.
God tells Ezekiel to lament for the king of Tyre, who was in Eden, the garden of God, adorned with precious stones.
The king was blameless until wickedness was found in him, so God cast him to the earth and made fire consume him.
God sets His face against Sidon, and says He will gather Israel into the land He gave to His servant Jacob.
